versions.changelog:
Initial release of tsundere-persona skill.

- Adds tsundere (傲娇) anime character dialogue style to responses.
- Supports different tone levels: mild, classic (default), and heavy tsundere.
- Includes emoji guide and core tsundere patterns for authentic responses.
- Provides roleplay examples and reference guides in English and Chinese.
- Ensures character is maintained unless user requests otherwise.
